limits: One consolidated development overview, not a held-out scored release;37 author-development cases retain permanent release exclusions.
Questions include dependent variants, correlated model routes, and unbalanced category counts. No independent-trial confidence claims.
Six domains have8 questions each; their apparent perfect scores are not reliability guarantees.
Timing pools retain original test dates, providers and request loads; this was not a synchronized rerun.
Costs retain captured API charges/tariffs; unknown costs are lower bounds, not zero.
First-attempt provider failures are unsuccessful delivered decisions, not wrong reasoning answers.
Ordinary LLMs without complete1342 coverage are references only, never ranked against the full-bank cohort.
No new model calls, unchanged question reruns or model removals. This is a public developmental overview, not a held-out release.
latency_definition: Median and linearly interpolated p95 from all1342 raw first-attempt durations; includes failures, excludes retry durations and wait/queue times.
